## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and uses Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Tests cover valid, malformed, unauthorized, and boundary inputs as applicable.
- [ ] Immutable versions, namespace ownership, independent moderation, signatures, archive limits, and audit history remain enforced.
- [ ] Both README languages and package policy were updated for public changes.
- [ ] New dependencies include purpose, license, runtime size, and deployment impact.
- [ ] No tokens, private keys, private packages, personal data, user Vaults, or build artifacts are included.
- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and follow the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
